title: Vintage E-Man Comic Lot Issues 5-8, First Comics 1983
descriptionText:
The VTG E-Man Comic Lot includes 4 issues from 1983 featuring the character E-Man, known for his unique power of transforming into various electrical appliances. Each issue is part of the E-Man series by artist/writer Joe Staton and published by First Comics under the US Comics tradition. These vintage comics hold a special place for collectors of comics and graphic novels, offering a glimpse into the superhero genre from the 1980s with a unique and imaginative storyline.

Vintage E Man comic series published by First Comics
Classic 1980s independent comic run with iconic artwork
Lot includes 4 issues
E Man No 5 Aug
E Man No 6 Sept
E Man No 7 Oct
E Man No 8 Nov
Features classic E Man stories including The Psychobabbler and Gantry Babbit
Great collector lot for fans of First Comics and vintage indie comics
You will receive the exact four comics shown in the photos
